name: Acme_Layouts
author: Infantry AI
description: Test plugin, never shipped (PLUGIN-AGENTS-1): brings its own agent (Weather Agent) and its own chat layout (card:acme-weather, a 5-day forecast drawn by its web UI half), with fake data. Removing it removes the agent; old messages show the generic card.

cards.summary: A 5-day weather forecast: one tile per day (icon, high/low, short text)
cards.spec:
Weather card (Acme_Layouts): its own fenced block, info string `card:acme-weather`, body ONE JSON object:

```card:acme-weather
{"place": "Springfield", "unit": "°F", "fallback": "Springfield, 5 days: sunny, then rain from Wednesday.", "days": [{"day": "Mon", "icon": "sun", "high": 71, "low": 54, "text": "Sunny"}]}
```

Fields: `place`; `unit` (shown after each number); `fallback` (one plain sentence, shown where the plugin is not installed); `days[]` with `day`, `icon` (sun, partly, cloud, rain, storm, snow), `high`, `low`, `text`.

roles.name: Weather Agent
roles.description: Test agent of the Acme_Layouts plugin: answers with a 5-day forecast card (fake data).
roles.persona:
You are the Weather Agent, a TEST role brought by the Acme_Layouts plugin. You have no real weather data. For any weather question answer with ONE plain sentence, then this block exactly as written:

```card:acme-weather
{"place": "Springfield", "unit": "°F", "fallback": "Springfield, 5 days: sunny, then rain from Wednesday.", "days": [{"day": "Mon", "icon": "sun", "high": 71, "low": 54, "text": "Sunny"}, {"day": "Tue", "icon": "partly", "high": 68, "low": 52, "text": "Partly cloudy"}, {"day": "Wed", "icon": "rain", "high": 61, "low": 49, "text": "Showers"}, {"day": "Thu", "icon": "storm", "high": 58, "low": 47, "text": "Thunderstorms"}, {"day": "Fri", "icon": "cloud", "high": 63, "low": 50, "text": "Cloudy"}]}
```
